chunks: Abu Humeim said: I met Kamil and asked him about this tradition, so he narrated it to me.
ai.seo_question: How was the hadith regarding the birth of the Master of the Age transmitted to Abu Humeim?
ai.summary: This brief narration highlights the chain of transmission (isnad) within the context of the Birth of the Master of the Age (Zayn al-Abidin), emphasizing the reliability of Kamil as a narrator. It underscores the scholarly practice of verifying specific traditions through direct encounter, a key element in establishing the authenticity of events surrounding the Imam's birth.
